definition: Reflective awareness — the I-awareness (ahaṃtā) by which consciousness turns back on itself and knows itself. The dynamic aspect of consciousness that makes self-recognition possible. Not mere reflection but the active grasping of oneself as oneself.

sources.claim: vimarśa is the defining characteristic of consciousness — without it, consciousness would be inert (jaḍa)
vimarśa as the self-awareness that constitutes the Lord's nature

translations.note: 'Reflective awareness' captures the active, self-turning aspect; 'reflection' is too passive; 'I-awareness' is technical but precise.
